The '''CQ-3.80''' was a [[multispectrum disguise suite]] incorporated into the [[TC-SC infiltration droid]] by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. It was an advanced [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] that was capable of completely disguising the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] exterior, even while moving.

==Description==
The CQ-3.80 was incorporated the [[TC-SC infiltration droid]] by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Combining high-definition, miniaturized holoprojectors, [[Speech scrambler/Legends|speech scramblers]], [[scanner]]s, and bio-sign generators, the CQ-3.80 could mimic any [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], [[Droid/Legends|droid]] or [[Sentience/Legends|sentient being]]. Because the TC-SC was built with exhaustive cultural and behavioral databases, the CQ-3.80's illusion was nearly impossible to detect except under intense and invasive scrutiny.<ref name="EV" />
